snippet.title: Begin The Slaughter Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
This is the trailer I made for Steam. It's gameplay focused, short and snappy. I have never made a trailer before.

The music is composed by One Man Orchestra,  https://onemansymphony.bandcamp.com 
This particular song is called "04 Chase Starts" from the "Reflective District" album.
They produce a lot of awesome royalty-free music, I can advise checking them out if you need some tracks for your video games!

I'm Murder Who, a solo indie game dev making their first video game project. My other gamedev friends saw my prototype and encouraged me to finish it, and hopefully by the end of the month, I'll have a fun lil' game. 

Here's the steam page if you want to wishlist it: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3946860/Begin_the_Slaughter
